senses.gloss:
mfn. (-युः-युः-यु)
Happy, prosperous, fortunate.
m. (-युः)
A sort of snake.
E.
शम् happily, and युस aff.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Happy, fortunate.
f. (-य्या)
Knowledge, understanding.
E.
शम् happily, यस् aff.

m. (-यः)
The skeleton.
E.
सम् together, यस to restrain, aff. ड.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Fortunate, prosperous.
m. (-वः)
1 The thunderbolt of INDRA.
2 The iron head of a pestle.
E.
शं good fortune, and व poss. aff.; also as differently derived, read शम्ब and सम्ब, &c.

n. (-रं)
Water.
E.
शं happily, वृ to choose or cover, aff. अरप्, more usually read शम्बर, q. v.

n. (-रं)
1 Water.
2 Self-control.
3 Covering, concealing.
m. (-रः)
1 The name of a demon.
2 Collection, comprehension.
3 Contraction, compression.
4 A mound, a bridge, &c.
E.
सम् before वृ to choose, aff. अप्, more usually derived from शम्ब or षम्ब to collect, and then written शम्बर or सम्बर q. v.

m. (-रः)
1 Contraction, diminution.
2 Compression of the lips, &c. in pronunciation.
E.
सम् before वृ to choose, aff. घञ्.

(उ,) शंसु r. 1st cl. (शंसति)
1 To praise.
2 To hurt.
3 To wish.
4 To calumniate.
With अभि prefixed,
To accuse wrongfully.
With आङ्
1 To hope.
2 To speak.
With प्र,
To praise, to flatter; this root and its derivatives are sometimes read with the palatal sibilant final or शंश, &c.

f. (-सा)
1 Speech.
2 Wish, desire.
3 Praise, flattery, eulogium.
E.
शंस to praise, &c. aff. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Certain, ascertained.
2 Calumniated, falsely accused.
3 Said, declared.
4 Praised, celebrated.
5 Wished, desired.
E.
शंस to wish, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Certain, certified, ascertained, established.
2 Completed, effected, finished.
3 Completing, effecting, diligent and attentive in accomplishing.
E.
सम् before शो to destroy, aff. क्त.

m. (-स्ता)
An encomiast, a panegyrist, a flatterer.
E.
शंस to praise, तृन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Happy, prosperous, well-faring.
E.
शं happily, स्था to stay or be^1, aff. क.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Happy, prosperous.
E.
शम् happily, ष्ठा to stay or be, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Staying, stopping, fixed, stationary.
2 Staying with, associated, domesticated.
m. (-स्थः)
1 A spy, a secret emissary.
2 A countryman, a neighbour, a person of the same country, &c.
3 A dweller, an inhabitant.
f. (स्था)
1 Continuance in the right way, correct conduct.
2 State or condition of being, time of life, &c.
3 Occupation, business, profession.
4 Stop, stay.
5 End, completion.
6 Manifestation, appearance.
7 Resemblance, likeness.
8 A sort of sacrifice.
9 Loss, destruction.
10 Death, dying.
11 Form.
12 An assembly.
13 A royal ordinance.
E.
सम् implying completeness, association, &c., and ष्ठा to stay, affs. क or अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
1 Desirable, to be wished.
2 Meritorious, to be praised.
E.
शंस to praise, &c. aff. क्यप्; also शस्य.

f. (-ली)
A shrub, (Pothos officinalis.)

f. (-र्णी)
A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.)
E.
सन the Asana or Pentaptera, and पर्ण a leaf; more usually असनपर्णी.

m. (-निः)
The planet SATURN or its regent.
E.
शो to destroy, or शण to give, aff. इन्.

m. (-निः)
1 Service, worship.
2 Giving, donation.
mf. (-निः-नी)
Request, solicitation, respectful solicitation as addressed to a spiritual preceptor, &c.
2 Quarter, region, point of the compass.
E.
षन to honour, to give, इनि Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.

n. (-जं)
Black pepper.
E.
शनि SATURN, and ज born.

f. (-सूः)
CHĀYA, the wife of the sun.
E.
शनि SATURN, and प्रसू the mother.

n. (-यं)
The emerald or sapphire.
E.
शनि SATURN, and प्रिय dear to.

m. (-रः)
Saturday.
E.
शनि the planet, and वार in this and similar compounds, a day.

m. (-रः)
The planet SATURN or its mythological personification.
E.
शनैस् slowly, and चर who goes.

ind.
1 Slowly, tardily.
2 Independantly, at will.
E.
शण to give, (to produce,) aff. ऐम्, and the consonant changed.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Made of Śiśu wood, &c.
E.
शिंशपा the Śiśu, अण् aff., and आङ् substituted for the first vowel.

r. 1st cl. intensitive form (शिशांसति-ते)
To whet, to sharpen.

m. (-नः)
1 A touchstone.
2 A grindstone.
f. (-नी)
A sort of cucumber.
E.
शो to make small or sharpen, aff. ल्युट्. also शाण.

(उ) षनु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते)
To give; also षण.

mf. (-नः-नी)
The flapping of an elephant's ears.
m. (-नः)
1 A plant, commonly Ghaṇṭāpārali.
2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
f. (-नी)
1 GAURĪ.
2 Light, lustre.
E.
षन to give, to serve, &c., aff. अच्.

ind.
Always, eternally, perpetually.
E.
षण to serve, आच aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Shrunk, diminished.
2 Lost, gone.
3 Still, motionless.
4 Dispirited.
n. (-न्नं)
A little, a small quantity.
E.
षद to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Calm, tranquil, pacified.
2 Allayed, alleviated.
3 Meek, humble.
4 Purified, cleansed, freed from, (as soil.)
5 Stilled, hushed, (as wind, &c.)
m. (-न्तः)
1 An ascetic, one whose passions are subdued and who is engrossed by meditating on the deity.
2 One of the Rasas or conditions of feeling, delineated in poetry or the drama, tranquillity or tranquil devotion, quietism, the assiduous exercise of meditation, &c. and indifference to all objects of pleasure or pain.
n. (-न्तं)
Appeasing, pacifying.
ind. (शान्तम)
A prohibitive particle or interjection, implying negation, aversion, disgust, (fie! for shame! Heaven forbid!)
E.
शम to be appeased, aff. क्त.

m. (-न्तः)
The hands opened and joined.

mfn. (-ताः-ता-तः)
Composed, calm, unanxious.
E.
शान्त, and चेतस् mind.

f. (-ता)
Quietness, calmness, meekness.
E.
शान्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शान्तत्वं.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Eternal, continual.
2 Spread, extended.
3 Continued, continuous.
4 Much, many.
n. adv. (-तं)
Eternally.
E.
सम् before तन to spread, aff. क्त.

m. (-वः)
BHĪṢMA, the reputed great uncle of the Pāṇḍavas.
E.
शान्तनु a prince, and अण् aff. of descent.

m. (-नुः)
The 21st sovereign of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the father of BHĪṢMA by Gaṅgā, or the Ganges personified.
E.
शं good fortune, (personified,) तनु the body, and the first vowel made long by special rule.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Exempt from soil, literally or figuratively.
E.
शान्त cleansed, and मल dirt.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Slackened in speed.
E.
शान्त, and रय rapidity.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Reconciled, appeased.
E.
शान्त, and विवाद dispute.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Calm, composed, of resigned or composed spirit.
E.
शान्त, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि)
Extinguished, put or gone out.
E.
शान्त, and अर्च्चिस् flame.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Quiet, tranquillity, stoicism, the absence of passion, and indifference to objects of pleasure or pain; it is especially applied to the tranquillity of devotion, or quietism, by which the mind is wholly fixed on the subject of its meditation or worship, and is utterly disregardless of external impressions.
2 Good fortune, auspiciousness, felicity.
3 Rest, repose.
4 Expiatory or propitiatory rites to avert any evil.
5 Preliminary ceremonies to avert inauspicious accidents at any religious celebration.
6 Remission, alleviation.
m. (-न्तिः)
1 The sixteenth Jina or Jaina deified sage of the present era.
2 One of the Jaina emperors of the universe.
E.
शम to be appeased, aff. क्तिन्.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 End, destruction.
2 Gift, giving.
E.
षण to give, क्तिच् aff.; also सति and साति.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Propitiatory, expiatory.
2 Producing ease or quiet, &c.
3 Relating to quiet, &c.
E.
शान्ति and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Tranquillising, calming, appeasing, &c.
E.
शान्ति, and कर who or what makes.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्री-र्त्तृ)
Conferring tranquillity, calming, appeasing.
m. (-र्त्ता)
Any divinity who averts evil.
E.
शान्ति, and कर्त्तृ who makes.

m. (-मः)
Desire of tranquillity and exemption from calamity.
E.
शान्ति peace, and काम desire.

n. (-हं)
A private apartment near the place of sacrifice.
E.
शान्ति devotion, गृह a house.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Tranquillising, calming, allaying.
E.
शान्ति, and द who or what gives.

m. (-मः)
Burnt offerings, to prevent or avert threatening or possible evils.
E.
शान्ति, and होम burnt offering.

n. (-दं)
Water offered at sacrifices for propitiation.
E.
शान्ति, and उद water; also शान्त्युदकं.

m. (-म्भः)
A vessel holding lustral water.
E.
शान्त्युद, and कुम्भ a jar.

r. 10th cl. (शान्त्वयति)
To console, to comfort.

n. (-न्त्वं)
1 Conciliation.
2 Comforting, consoling.
E.
शम to appease or allay (opposition), deriv. irr.; or शान्त्व to console, aff. अच्; also सान्त्व.

r. 10th cl. (सान्त्वयति)
To console, to comfort; also सान्त्व.

r. 10th cl. (सान्त्वयति)
1 To appease, to conciliate.
2 To comfort; also षान्त्व.

mn. (-न्त्वः-न्त्वं)
1 Conciliation, reconciling, appeasing.
2 Pleasing and conciliatory language.
3 Cleverness, dexterity.
E.
सान्त्व to console or appease, अच् aff.

f. (-तिः)
A plant, (Siphonanthus indica.)

ind.
(In composition,) With, together with, &c.; being the optional form of writing सम् before a consonant: before consonants of the first five classes, the Anusvāra may be again changed to the nasal of the class to which the letter it precedes belongs, as सं for सम्, and कल्प make सङ्कल्प, &c.: before the semivowels, the sibilants, and ह, it preferably remains unaltered; practice however is very arbitrary in this respect, and the change is expressed or not, in all manuscripts according to the pleasure of the writer.

mf. (-यत्)
War, battle.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Checked, restrained, controuled, suppressed.
2 Bound, confined, fettered, imprisoned.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Self-subdued, of well regulated spirit.
E.
संयत, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of subdued or controuled passions and desires.
E.
संयत, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

m. (-रः)
A king, a prince.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.; or संयत् war, वर chief.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Constraining, a constrainer.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, aff. तृच्.

m. (-मः)
1 Restraint, forbearance.
2 Humanity, avoiding the infliction of pain on others.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, aff. अप्.

m. (-मः)
1 Forbearance, check, controul, restraint.
2 Humanity, abstaining from giving pain to others.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
Curbing, restraining, subduing, who or what does so.
E.
सम् before यम to restrain, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Restraining, checking.
2 Forbearance, self-denial or controul.
3 Binding, confinement.
4 Holding, detaining.
5 A religious vow or obligation.
6 A cluster of four houses.
f. (-नी)
The capital of YAMA.
E.
सम् implying completeness, or entirely, and यम to restrain, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Checked, controuled, restrained.
2 Bound, confined, held, detained.
E.
सम् before यम to check, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Who or what checks, restrains, curbs, &c.
m. (-मी)
A saint, a sage, one who subdues or controuls his passions.
E.
संयम restraint, इनि aff.

f. (-त्रा)
Travelling into another island or continent, voyaging, travelling by water.
E.
सम् before या to go, त्रन् aff.

m. (-नः)
A mould.
n. (-नं)
Accompanying, going together.
E.
सम् together, या to go or get, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Forbearing.
E.
संयाम, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-वः)
A sort of roll, or a thin cake of unleavened bread, fried with Ghee, pounded and again made up into an oblong form with fresh bread, sugar, and spices, and again fried with Ghee.
E.
सम् together, यु to mix, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Joined with, connected, attached.
2 Mixed, blended.
3 Endowed with, possessed of.
4 Accompanied or attended by.
E.
सम् together, युज to join, aff. क्त.

m. (-गः)
1 War, battle.
2 Union, mixture.
E.
सम् before युज to join, क aff.

mfn. (-युक्)
1 Possessed of or endowed with good qualities.
2 Connected or associated with.
3 Joined, united.
E.
सम् before युज to join, aff. क्विप्, and the consonant unchanged.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Connected, joined, mixed, blended, attached to.
E.
सम् together, यु to join, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to mix, join, unite, to bring together in any way.
E.
सम् before यु to join, desid. v., उ aff.

m. (-गः)
1 Intimate union or association.
2 Living with, being in company with.
3 Adherence, junction.
4 (In grammar,) A conjunct consonant.
E.
सम् before युज to join, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Joined, annexed, connected.
E.
संयोग union, इतच् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Copulation, coition.
2 Joining, uniting.
E.
सम् with, युज to join, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Joined, attached, annexed.
E.
सम् together, युज to join, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Inflamed, angry.
2 Empassioned.
E.
सम् before रञ्ज to be affected, क्त aff.

m. (-क्षः)
Care, preservation, protection.
E.
सम्, and रक्ष preserving.

n. (-णं)
Taking care of, protecting, preserving.
E.
मम् before रक्ष to preserve, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taken care of, preserved, protected.
E.
सम् before रक्ष to preserve, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Fit, proper, or necessary to be taken care of, guarded, preserved, &c.
E.
सम् before रक्ष to preserve, यत् aff.; also संरक्षणीय and संरक्षितव्य.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Incensed, angry.
2 Agitated.
E.
सम् before रभि to sound, क्त aff.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Wrath, rage.
2 Pride, arrogance.
3 Flurry, agitation.
4 Swelling with heat and redness.
E.
सम् before रभि to sound, and घञ् aff.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Exceedingly harsh, rough, or scurrilous.
E.
संरम्भ, and परुष harsh.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Angry, resentful.
E.
संरम्भ, and रस taste.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Wrath.
2 Pride.
3 Agitation.
E.
संरम्भिन्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, संरम्भिता.

mfn. (-म्भी-म्भिनी-म्भि)
1 Proud.
2 Angry.
3 Flurried.
E.
संरम्भ, and इनि aff.

m. (-गः)
1 Anger.
2 Affection.
E.
सम्, रञ्ज to be affected, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Propitiating, pleasing by worship.
E.
सम् before राध to accomplish, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Propitiated, pleased.
E.
सम् before राध to accomplish, क्त aff.

m. (-वः)
Sound, noise.
E.
सम् before रु to sound, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Roaring, shouting, making a noise or uproar.
E.
सम् before रु to sound, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Checked, stopped, impeded, curbed, opposed.
E.
सम् before रुध to obstruct, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Confident, audacious, presuming.
2 Budded, blossomed.
E.
सम् before रुह to grow, aff. क्त.

m. (-धः)
1 Hindering, stopping, opposing, preventing.
2 Impediment, obstruction.
3 Bond, fetter.
4 Curb, check.
5 Throwing, sending.
E.
सम् before रुध to obstruct, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
Distinguishing, characterising.
E.
सं before लक्ष to mark, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Marked, distinguished.
E.
सम् before लक्ष to mark, क्त aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
To be marked with or by.
E.
सम् before लक्ष to mark, यत् aff.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Joined, united, adherent.
E.
सम्, and लग्न attached to.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ashamed.
E.
सम् before लस्ज to be ashamed, शानच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Sleep, sleepiness.
E.
सं before ली to join, and अच् aff.

m. (-पः)
1 Conversation, discourse.
2 In the drama, high discourse, dialogue of profound or occult meaning.
E.
सम् with, together with, and लप to speak, aff. घञ्.

n. (-कं)
A species of minor drama, a controversial drama.
E.
संलाप, कन् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Discoursing, conversing.
E.
संलाप, and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Discoursing, who or what discourses.
E.
संलाप, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Increasing.
E.
सम्, वहि to grow, causal v., शतृ aff.

m. (-रः)
A year.
E.
सम् with, completely, and वत्सर a year; or सम् with वस to abide, सर Uṇādi aff., and त substituted for the final.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Annual, perennial.
m. (-रः)
An astrologer.
E.
संवत्सर a year, अण् aff.

ind.
1 A year.
2 A year of VIKRAMĀDITYA'S era.
E.
सम् before वद to speak, aff. विच्, or सम् before वय to go, क्विप् aff., य rejected, and तुक् final augment.

n. (-नं)
1 Communication of tidings or intelligence.
2 Sight, seeing.
nf. (-नं-ना)
1 Subduing by charms, overpowering any thing or person by magical compounds, or drugs, or mystical gems, &c.
2 A charm, an amulet, the article by which the above is effected.
E.
सम् with वद to speak, युच् aff.

n. (-नं-ना)
Subduing by magical drugs or charms: see the last.
E.
सम् before वन to ask, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 Destruction of the universe.
2 Beleric myrobalan.
3 The name of a Muni.
4 A cloud.
